title: Respiratory Deterioration (SpO2/RR)
scenario: A 60-year-old client admitted with community-acquired pneumonia is monitored over six hours on a medical unit. The nurse reviews the respiratory flowsheet.

questions.subject: Medical-Surgical
questions.stem: How should the nurse interpret the trend shown in the flowsheet?

options.text: The client is deteriorating with worsening hypoxemia despite escalating oxygen
The client is improving as oxygen therapy is increased
The client is stable and respiratory support can be weaned
The changes are within normal limits and need no action

questions.rationale: SpO2 continues to fall and respiratory rate and work of breathing continue to rise even as supplemental oxygen is increased, indicating progressive respiratory failure rather than improvement.

questions.subject: Medical-Surgical
questions.stem: Complete the sentence. The trend indicates the client is experiencing {1}, and the nurse should first {2}.

choices.text: notify the provider and prepare for escalated respiratory support

questions.rationale: The falling SpO2 with rising respiratory rate and effort despite increasing oxygen reflects worsening respiratory failure; the priority is to escalate to the provider for higher-level respiratory support.
